STYLE INVARIANTS: whole FOOTLESS continuous charcoal-black ink splat bodies with subtle violet sheen; thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, hands continuous goo, exposed body dominant. UPRIGHT facing viewer/front3quarter. Rich modeled plasticine, tactile fingerprints, soft sculpted lids/lips, uneven ivory teeth. Clearly WHITE/ivory eyeballs surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil, even when half-lidded. Never all-red eyes. Cartoon acting at expressive peak, offbeat handmade stop-motion, not Pixar cute baby mascots, not realistic human bodies/dolls. No feet/legs, no full robes/armour replacing goo, no skinny limbs, no hypercomplex gear. Few beautiful fat wooden/cloth/metal/clay prop volumes; simple physical relation and satirical character, no floating punctuation or random anatomy.

TOP ROW: male TODESRITTER. FIXED IDENTITY across3: heavy upright round-bottom ink splat with drooping crown lobes and an extra long thick lower lip, THREE uneven upper ivory teeth, tiny worn black-grey brow helmet with one broken nub, faded icy-teal collar strip. All eyes WHITE/red/black not glowing.
LEFT TRASH: Dejected sleepy asymmetrical eyes, open sagging jaw. Holds ONE tiny rusty FLAIL: fat short handle, very short chain, ONE rounded iron ball resting against own body, no floating weapon.
MIDDLE COMMON: Indignant teeth clenched, eyebrows uneven, torso goo leans forward. Same compact flail now dark iron with blunt rounded studs, same broken helmet nub.
RIGHT ELITE: Terminally bored half-lids, huge pout and teeth barely peeking. Same flail beautifully dark steel and worn brass, tiny shoulder plate, SAME broken nub/collar; no skull mask/bones/ribcage.

BOTTOM ROW: FEMALE-READ BARDE. FIXED IDENTITY across3: medium tall curvy upright ink pear with a wavy crown quiff, long soft lids/lashes, two widely spaced upper ivory teeth, little plum beret with ONE drooping coral feather, narrow mustard collar.
LEFT TRASH: Shy near-closed worried lips, eyes sideways. Cradles ONE tiny crooked wooden three-string LUTE, one string visibly slack but physical and contained.
MIDDLE COMMON: Wild delighted sideways open tooth laugh, one eye shut, body flexed upright. SAME lute now neat polished wood with thick ivory soundhole rim, same beret/feather.
RIGHT ELITE: Withering diva side-eye, closed thick curled lip and two teeth. Same beautiful little lute with brass fittings and one tiny copper shoulder tassel, same feather, no stage/mic/music-note symbols.
EMPTY SPACE AND HOLES HAVE ACTUAL ALPHA ZERO, no coloured backdrop/gradient/scenery/floor/cast shadow/shadow disc/checkerboard/text/logos/borders. Opaque figures with soft edge antialias only. Materials/lighting cohesive, each ROW different face choreography, no universal angry V-brow grin. Gear escalation stays plausible and simple; absurdity comes from behaviour and objects, not clutter.
LAYOUT OVERRIDE: make ALL figures SMALLER with at least64px clear margin per512px cell, total figure bounding box MAX384x384 pixels. Centres at(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Preserve complete big thick blob design but leave generous invisible gutters, don't fill the canvas. Uniform equal boxes, no protrusions crossing cell boundaries.
